##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 15 July 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred to the north of Scotland.


##Wind##

East or northeast 2 to 4, occasionally 5 in places at first, especially in the south and towards the Solway Firth, becoming northerly or variable in the afternoon, then easterly overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 2 to 4, backing northerly for a time, occasionally 5 in the northeast overnight into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair. Small risk of mist and fog patches developing.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, small risk of poor or very poor.
